title: Grey four-fingered beings with a wand, telepathic instruction to comply

tellings.quote: I was told not to resist, not to fight. I wasn't in any danger. Just comply and everything will be all right.

plain: Charlie Foltz, one of the men involved in what is known as the Allagash abductions, says that in 1976, on the Allagash Waterway in Maine, he was taken by grey beings with four fingers who held a wand. He says they spoke to him silently, mind to mind: "I was told not to resist, not to fight. I wasn't in any danger. Just comply and everything will be all right." Foltz tells this as something that happened to him, and he points to a book about the case called The Allagash Abductions.
